uplink.description: Onboard climate: battery 3.60 V, temperature 23.5 C, humidity 51.5 % (no input field -> no channels)
uplink._note: Synthetic in-bounds frame; expected values produced by running reference/upstream-codec.js (battery_voltage signed16*0.01, temperature signed16*0.1, relative_humidity u8*0.5) and mapping temperature->air.temperature, relative_humidity->air.relativeHumidity, battery_voltage(V)->battery. The frame carries no input TLV, so the lazily-built `channels` key is omitted entirely — the common case for this device.

uplink.description: Full I/O sweep: battery, outputs, negative temperature, humidity, all three input terminals (contact + counter, 4-20 mA loop, 0-10 V), MCU temperature
uplink._note: Synthetic in-bounds frame exercising every port-10 channel; expected values produced by running reference/upstream-codec.js. temperature 0xFFCE = -50 -> -5.0 C (two's complement); mcu_temperature 0x012C = 300 -> 30.0 C. Input terminals map to channels[] entries (zero-based labels; input0 = TEKTELIC input 1): input_1 = 1 -> input0 action.contactState 'closed'; input_1_count 0x002A = 42 -> input0 pulse.count (the counter is input 1's only); input_2 0x2710 = 10000 microamps -> input1 analog.current 10 mA (upstream reports the same raw count as 0.01 A); input_3 0x03E8 = 1000 mV -> input2 analog.voltage 1 V (unchanged from upstream's 1). Onboard temperature/humidity map to air.*; battery_voltage(V)->battery; the MCU diagnostic and the commanded output states stay top-level.

uplink.description: Mixed input frame: open contact with a non-zero counter, 4 mA loop current, 7.5 V analog input (per-position truth, no onboard climate field)
uplink._note: Synthetic; expected values cross-checked against reference/upstream-codec.js, which decodes this frame as input_1 = 0, input_2 = 0.004 (A), input_3 = 7.5 (V), input_1_count = 12345. Each terminal carries a distinct value so a swapped position would fail: input_1 state byte 0 -> input0 'open' while its counter still reports 12345 (an open contact does not clear the count); input_2 0x0FA0 = 4000 microamps -> input1 4 mA (loop live at its 4 mA zero point); input_3 0x1D4C = 7500 mV -> input2 7.5 V.

uplink.description: Sparse frame: temperature plus the 0-10 V terminal only -> a single channels entry, 0 V emitted (no sentinel)
uplink._note: Synthetic; reference/upstream-codec.js decodes the same frame as temperature 23.5, input_3 = 0. TEKTELIC uplinks are sparse TLV streams: only the reported terminal gets an entry (no fabricated input0/input1), and because the wire format defines no disconnected sentinel a genuine 0 V reading is emitted rather than suppressed.
Synthetic. Header 0xAB 0xCD is not in the port-10 descriptor table; upstream reports this as a `data.error` ('Couldn't find header...'), this codec returns it via the {errors} contract instead.
